title: Unverifiable fill fails closed and blocks new entries
statement: When the venue reports an order filled but the fill details cannot be substantiated, the live executor records a recovery discrepancy, keeps the cash reservation, returns a rejected outcome, and refuses every later entry until an operator reconciles; an unrelated ValueError still propagates.
failure_mode: A bare ValueError escaped submit_signal and real exposure went untracked while the next signal sized against cash that may already have been spent.
